name: Spite increases Agility and dodge chance by 7%/2% or 14%/5% (#3176)
contract: Spite increases Agility by 8% (rank 1, 800188) or 15% (rank 2, 803840) via native SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE (aura 137; EffectBasePoints 7/14, die 1 => CalcValue 8/15), and dodge chance by a flat 3 (rank 1) or 6 (rank 2) via native SPELL_AURA_MOD_DODGE_PERCENT (aura 49; EffectBasePoints 2/5, die 1 => CalcValue 3/6). Player::GetDodgeFromAgility (StatSystem.cpp) also feeds the extra Agility into dodge: SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE only scales the BASE_PCT group, so the whole Agility increase lands in bonus_agility (the uncapped, non-diminishing-formula term that UpdateDodgePercentage adds straight into the exposed dodge_chance stat), pushing total measured dodge chance slightly above the flat 3/6. The two effects are isolated below via spell_effect_value (the native CalcValue of Spite's own dodge effect) and confirmed live in-game via a lower-bound dodge_chance check.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1 dodge effect's own native value is +3 (isolates the dodge aura from the Agility-fed contribution to total dodge chance)
Rank 2 dodge effect's own native value is +6 (isolates the dodge aura from the Agility-fed contribution to total dodge chance)
Rank 1 dodge chance rises ~3.31 points in-game (flat +3 aura plus the extra 8% Agility's own dodge contribution)
Rank 2 dodge chance rises by at least 6 points in-game (flat +6 aura; the extra 15% Agility can only add further dodge, never subtract)
